lines: Woh kabhi mil jaaye to kya kijiye
couplets.en: If we should meet someday, what would I do?

lines: Raat din soorat ko dekha kijiye
couplets.en: I would gaze at that face night and day.

lines: Woh kabhi mil jaaye to kya kijiye
couplets.en: If we should meet someday, what would I do?

lines: Chaandni raaton mein ek ek phool ko
couplets.en: On moonlit nights, each flower in turn awaits a bow.
Rapture whispers that I should bow.

lines: Jo tamanna bar na aaye umr bhar
couplets.en: Some longings go a lifetime unfulfilled.
Go on longing for it all your life.

lines: Ishq ki rangeeniyon mein doob kar
couplets.en: Lose yourself in the colors of love.
Let yourself weep on moonlit nights.

lines: Hum hi uske ishq ke qaabil na the
couplets.en: I was the one unworthy of their love.

lines: Kyun kisi zaalim ka shikwa kijiye
couplets.en: Why reproach the one who was cruel?
